plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: A task loop for coding agents: an approved spec, a worker in its own worktree, a deterministic gate, and an independent review that cannot edit.

plugins.name: pit-crew-planning
plugins.description: Upstream of crew: brainstorm, architecture and feature maps traced to evidence, an interrogation pass on what is unresolved, and gated task packets that refuse to be generated while anything is unverified.
